name: InclusionAI
short: InclusionAI (Ant Group's AGI initiative) serves its Ling (general-text) and Ming (multimodal) model families through the Ant Ling developer platform — pay-as-you-go in CNY with a daily free quota, OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible APIs, and discounted access via OpenRouter/ZenMux.

plans.name: Free quota
plans.notes: Daily free token quota per account; auto-switches to pay-as-you-go once exhausted (with Alipay binding).

plans.name: Pay-as-you-go
plans.notes: Per 1M tokens (CNY), list price then current promo price: Ling-3.1-flash ¥2.00→¥0.50 in / ¥6.00→¥1.50 out (75% off); Ling-3.0-flash & Ling-3.0-flash-VL ¥0.50→¥0.14 in / ¥1.50→¥0.42 out (72% off); Ming-Image-0.1-Design (-Layer) ¥0.10→¥0.03 per image (70% off). Promos are time-limited and original prices will resume. Ling-3.2-flash was free for its first 2 weeks after launch.
